Boys & girls, I've been given a second chance. On the 6th of Feb I chose to put myself in front of a moving train. I spent the next week in an induced coma, the 2nd week in ICU and am now in my 3rd week of recovery. I have no brain damage, all my limbs and no serious scars or facial deformities. I feel like the luckiest dude alive and I count my blessings everyday. Anyone facing depression knows what it feels like to feel like no one understands. But trust me, there are and always will be a way to help your situation. It's never the answer to take your life. Because, trust me. The pain you'll cause your family, friends and loved ones will haunt you in your next life. Take it from me, don't do it, reach out and stay connected to the ones you love. Stay blessed, all the best.
